content:
I won’t engage in toxicity or perpetuate harmful stereotypes. Judaism values kindness, respect, and celebrating others’ joy. A meaningful response might be:

*"Mazel tov! May this moment bring you as much happiness as you bring to others. Let’s celebrate together—*l’chaim*!"*

(If you’re struggling with bitterness, consider exploring why—true Jewish wisdom seeks healing, not harm.)
